description: This file defines a React component for the homepage of a web application. It handles user input, manages job submissions, polls for job status updates, handles errors, and visualizes graph data resulting from a job.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Sets the polling state to true to initiate status polling.

methods.name: stopPolling
methods.description: Sets the polling state to false to stop status polling.

methods.name: scheduleNextPoll
methods.description: Schedules the next status poll after a delay, handles polling logic and response processing.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of user input, initiates job submission, and manages related UI state.

methods.name: handleTogglePolling
methods.description: Toggles the polling state between active and inactive.

methods.name: handleFetchErrors
methods.description: Fetches errors for the current job based on jobId.
